label: Constructs synthesis ignores or rejects
subgoals: Drop delays and print tasks from the synthesized model
Reject event waits and fork-join in synthesizable code
Treat initial values as FPGA-only and use reset for ASICs

label: Static loops, functions and memories
subgoals: Unroll loops whose bounds are compile-time constants
Inline timing-free functions as combinational logic
Match array access patterns to the RAM the target provides

label: Simulation-synthesis mismatches
subgoals: Spot constructs whose simulation meaning differs from their hardware
Replace pragmas and partial sensitivity lists with checked constructs
Confirm the netlist against the RTL with equivalence checking
